findings.question: q-physics-kinematics-0009
findings.quote: - text: "Yes: \"dropped\" gives no information about initial velocity."
findings.problem: The stem asks for an initial velocity, but only "Zero" supplies a velocity. All three distractors are Yes/No statements answering a different question. A student can select the only choice that fits the question without knowing what "released from rest" means.
findings.fix: Replace the three distractors with plausible initial velocities in the same form as the correct choice, and revise their notes to match.

findings.question: q-physics-kinematics-0012
findings.quote: This adds the acceleration magnitude instead of using its opposite direction. The five is printed as a positive magnitude. Check the direction relative to initial motion.
findings.problem: The note incorrectly says the acceleration is printed as a positive magnitude. The stem explicitly prints acceleration as -5 m/s². The 50 m/s mistake comes from ignoring that minus sign and calculating 30 + 5(4).
findings.fix: Replace the middle sentence with "Ignoring the minus sign can make adding 5 each second seem right."
